scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate --workspace server && npm run prisma:migrate --workspace server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @team-management/shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @team-management/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @team-management/shared && npm run lint --workspace server && npm run lint --workspace client
